hazards.evidence: Gas/electric stove on the left has cookware sitting on the burners and exposed front control knobs with no knob covers, so burners can be turned on freely.
Knife block with multiple knives standing out on the countertop within easy reach.
Several pill/medication bottles and a blue-and-white compartment pill organizer left out on the counter next to the knives.
Bottled product (appears to be a cleaning/soap chemical) sitting out by the sink, unlocked and within reach.
